profile.name: Fozayel Ibn Ayaz
profile.title: Full-stack developer · Dhaka, Bangladesh
profile.shortIntroduction: I build WordPress platforms and web apps, wire up the analytics behind them, and keep the whole thing running in production.
biography: I'm a full-stack developer and data analyst based in Dhaka. Day to day that means JavaScript, React and Next.js on the front end, PHP and Node.js on the back end, and WordPress as a serious delivery platform — ACF architectures, WooCommerce, Core Web Vitals budgets.
On the data side I work with SQL, Python, GA4 and GTM, and build Looker Studio dashboards that teams actually use — including forecasting with Prophet, ARIMA and LSTM models.

Currently a WordPress developer at Ekomedia and IT administrator at Café Lavista; previously a data analyst at Eagle 3D Streaming. I care about measurable work: fast pages, clean tracking, and deployments that don't surprise anyone.

projects.name: AI YouTube Command Center
bullets: Creators had data scattered across YouTube Studio, sheets and guesswork.
Built a dashboard that ingests YouTube Analytics and generates plain-language insights.
Faster content decisions; weekly review time cut from hours to minutes.
projects.shortDescription: Analytics command center for creators who want the story behind the numbers.
projects.description: An AI-powered YouTube channel command center built with Next.js and TypeScript. It integrates OAuth-based YouTube Analytics across more than 12 endpoints for views, retention, subscribers, search terms and per-video breakdowns, alongside an AI chat assistant with more than 30 function-calling tools. Scheduled GitHub Actions run filtered alerts and weekly/monthly digests; the application is deployed on Vercel with production CI.
caseStudy: Integrated YouTube Analytics OAuth data across 12+ endpoints, including views, retention, subscriber growth, search terms and per-video performance.
Built an AI chat assistant with 30+ function-calling tools for on-demand channel insights.
Added spam-filtered notifications and scheduled weekly/monthly digests with GitHub Actions; deployed to Vercel.

projects.name: Eagle 3D Streaming BI Hub
bullets: Reporting lived in five tools; nobody trusted a single number.
Consolidated GA4, GTM, billing and product events into Looker Studio with automated refresh.
Anomaly alerts reached the team the same day; leadership ran Monday reviews from one link.
projects.shortDescription: One operational view for KPIs, customers, revenue and anomalies.
projects.description: A production analytics platform built with Python, Streamlit and MongoDB. It brings KPI scraping, YouTube OAuth analytics, customer-success tracking and a payment ledger for new and recurring revenue into a secure ten-page dashboard. Automated data pipelines run four times a day, with 15-minute anomaly detection and 16 Telegram alert types.
caseStudy: Unified KPI scraping, YouTube OAuth analytics, customer-success tracking and the payment ledger in a ten-page dashboard.
Automated the data pipeline to run four times daily and detect anomalies every 15 minutes.
Configured 16 Telegram alert types for operational notifications.
